designReview.evidence: Independent bounded R2 review confirmed all .NET test shards run on windows-latest while only the evidence finalizer runs on ubuntu-latest. A constant zero Bootstrap skip count therefore describes the producer and removes finalizer-host confusion without changing test commands, inventory, execution, coverage, production runtime, firmware semantics, or generic mismatch rejection. The matching regression freezes 1,147 Bootstrap passes and two unchanged aggregate Infrastructure skips.
